title: Interaction-Surface Transport, Prospective Same-State Aliasing Search, Context×Geometry Policy Reconstruction, Cross-Ecosystem Action Reversal, Representation-Invariance Audit, Hidden-Coordinate Falsification & the Boundary of (X,G,E) State Sufficiency

material_equivalence.purpose: Prevent representation-only differences from masquerading as state differences or aliases.
quotient_out: path spelling when semantic reachability is unchanged
must_preserve: runtime/toolchain provenance that changes reachable behavior
material_equivalence.equivalence_rule: Two worlds may count as materially same (X,G,E) only after normalization when no preserved action-relevant coordinate differs.
material_equivalence.burden: SAME_STATE requires explicit field-by-field custody; superficial similarity is insufficient.

prospective_program.fresh_transport: Test the P10 interaction-bearing policy on projects/ecosystems not used to establish P10.
prospective_program.matched_context: Approximately hold X fixed while varying G; require action-family discrimination.
prospective_program.matched_geometry: Approximately hold G fixed while varying X; require context-conditioned action reversal or discrimination.
prospective_program.same_state_alias_search: Search prospectively for normalized same (X,G,E) with distinct actions.
prospective_program.representation_invariance: Re-encode the same world under alternate naming/schema projections and require the Court verdict to remain unchanged.
prospective_program.hidden_coordinate_falsification: For every alias candidate, attempt reconstruction inside X, G, or E before declaring missing ontology.

fatal_r2_gate.criterion: A fresh prospectively admitted pair remains materially identical in (X,G,E) after normalization and hidden-coordinate reconstruction, yet requires conflicting actions under comparable authority.
